purpose: Relevance prefilter before live memory source validation

actual_measurement.scope: Application secure read_source invocations; not OS file reads or model token/cost telemetry

unchanged_semantics: All lexically eligible or prior-attempt category candidates retain live freshness validation before ranking; no early top-ten cap
No persistent source/hash cache; selected source-backed evidence still rechecked before atomic retrieval publication
intentional_side_effect: Irrelevant claims no longer get opportunistically marked stale during unrelated context selection; future relevant selection, public recall, and explicit snapshot check current source
